title: Ansel and the Interior
author: Juniper Yarrow
blurb: Cyrus Lockridge, a restaurant critic who has forgotten how food tastes, moves through the days like a tenant, not an owner. Then a song on the radio is one that was written and never recorded — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must ask the question the whole family arranged itself around, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
